name: How to Convert PDF to JPG or PNG Free
description: Export every page of a PDF as a high-quality JPG or PNG image — free, no upload, processed locally in your browser.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based PDF to image converter, no upload required

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. The file loads in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.

step.name: Choose format and resolution
step.text: Select JPG or PNG output format. Choose your preferred resolution: 72 DPI (screen/web), 150 DPI (balanced), or 300 DPI (print quality). Higher DPI produces sharper images at larger file sizes.

step.name: Convert and download
step.text: Click 'Convert to JPG'. Each page is rendered as a separate image file. Multiple pages download as a ZIP archive. Nothing is sent to any server at any step.
